en: Fixed a prompt starting with `/`, sent with the Agent SDK's `verbatimPrompts` option, running as a slash command when `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-ran it after a restart
zh: 修复了以 `/` 开头的 prompt 在使用 Agent SDK 的 `verbatimPrompts` 选项发送、并在重启后由 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 重新执行时被当作斜杠命令运行的问题
